release_notes: Next-generation interface with Dashboard, Video Downloads, Browser Integration, Analytics, Performance, Advanced Settings, Update Center and Notifications.
New IDM Video Assistant extension for Chrome and Edge that sends supported direct media links to IDM.
Native messaging protocol v2 with validated media metadata and a signed-in installer upgrade path.
Database schema v4 with verified pre-migration backups; existing history, settings, queue and paths are preserved.
Installer registers browser integration without silently installing extensions and keeps user data during in-place upgrades.
